rfp_contact: Dennis Orellana, Procurement Services Lead, fco.procurement@usask.ca
submission_method: Online Bonfire Portal at https://usask.bonfirehub.ca; file formats listed in Requested Information; maximum upload file size 1000 MB; Java/JavaScript must be enabled; cookies must be enabled.
contract_term: September 1, 2025 to August 31, 2030 (5 years); maximum potential period of ten (10) years with one additional three-year and one additional two-year extension.
scope_of_deliverables: Provision and/or installation of Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) Software; AI Chat and Data Analysis Services; AI Model Customization and Integration; AI Consulting Services; AI Enabling Infrastructure.
mandatory_submission_requirements: Table of contents; corporate structure and ownership; company experience; list of proposed personnel; pricing structure in Canadian dollars; sample of service/maintenance agreement; minimum of three (3) references; sustainability summary; indication of brokered services; Validation of Proposal and Acceptance of Contractual Provisions (Appendix A); HECVAT or Software As A Service Form (Appendix E); disclosure of litigation.
mandatory_technical_requirements: Compliance with Intellectual Property and Privacy Regulations (Copyright Act, PIPEDA, LA FOIP, HIPA); Infrastructure Protection; Security and Data Protection Requirements (USask SaaS Form or HECVAT); Integration and User Management (SSO, user account management, role and access provisioning).
evaluation_criteria: a) TECHNICAL & AI PLATFORM SERVICES (30 points); b) OPTIONAL SERVICES (5 points); c) PROFESSIONAL SERVICES (5 points); d) PROPONENT QUALIFICATIONS (10 points); e) SUPPORT & MANAGEMENT (10 points); f) COST (30 points); g) UNIVERSITY BENEFIT & SUSTAINABILITY (5 points); h) INDIGENOUS PARTICIPATION (5 points).
pricing_requirements: Canadian dollars; GST and PST excluded; DDP Incoterms 2010; firm for five (5) years; pricing schedule for all departments and affiliates; breakdown of price per user subscription; volume discounts; implementation, training, and maintenance fees.
minimum_insurance_requirements: Commercial General Liability Insurance: $5,000,000.00 CAD per occurrence; Cybersecurity Liability Insurance: $5,000,000.00 CAD per occurrence; certificates of insurance required.
vendor_experience_qualifications: Demonstrated ability to work in a large university environment; relevant experience, competence, and reliability in handling similar projects.
number_of_references_required: Minimum of three (3) references for similar services, including company name, contact name, title, telephone number, and email address.
data_security_privacy_requirements: Compliance with Copyright Act, PIPEDA, LA FOIP, and HIPA; USask SaaS Form or HECVAT; data protection strategies including encryption and regular security audits; IMSP requirements under The Local Authority Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act.
data_hosting_residency_requirements: Vendors must specify where university data is stored and who it is hosted by; data centre location and hosting provider details required in the SaaS Vendor Form.
vendor_demonstration_requirement: Proponents may be contacted after the RFP closing to arrange for presentations to clarify Proposals, product demonstrations, or an inspection of their operations.
